cluster_gate_treatment: Use S=1, the low-acceleration asymptote and maximum possible galaxy-locked route fraction, because the ten-cluster member-light proxy has no physical mass normalization from which to calculate g_b(R80).
claim_limits: P0592 already disclosed the galaxy-locked candidate's ensemble target score, so this is a parameter replay and not an untouched cluster formula holdout.
Setting the unavailable acceleration gate to S=1 is favorable to the model and gives the largest transferred spatial correction, not a measured cluster activation.
Normalized map morphology cannot test absolute lensing amplitude or distinguish modified gravity from dark mass.
The cluster baryon proxy omits hot gas, ICL, and stellar mass-to-light variations.
